# pumpfun-github-claims

> Pump.fun GitHub Claims: first-time fee claims for GitHub-linked coins. Price, market cap, developer history and socials. Read-only Telegram feed.

pumpfun-github-claims is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-github-claims/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
